answer: Identities funded from a common source within 7 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the prism graph is rebuilt each epoch, the comet merge is applied at settlement and the summit audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 38 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
